_comment: Content of the hero banner. Edit the lines, push, and the Banner workflow redraws both themes. 'cmd' lines get the accent prompt, 'hi' is a highlighted answer, 'out' is secondary text.
title: profile.sh --live

source._comment: 'image' is the original; build.py runs it through dotify into 'file'. Drop 'image' to fall back to the monogram cache.
source._field_help: Minimum ink in every cell. 0 for a portrait, so the face sits on the panel instead of inside a rectangle of grey dots. A monogram wants ~0.1.

dotify._invert_help: true = ink where the photo is DARK. Right for a dark-haired subject on a pale wall; it also keeps the wall out of the panel for free.
dotify._crop_help: left,top,right,bottom as fractions, centred on the face. Pulled back far enough to clear the chin; any wider and the monitor and the window blind start creeping into frame.
dotify._shape_help: 84x112 puts roughly three screen pixels under each dot at the width GitHub renders the README. Lower and the face turns to blocks; higher and it turns to mush.
dotify._vignette_help: Fades ink toward the edges so the room falls away and the face is what is lit.
